title: 4.1 Rooms at Home
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Name the rooms of a home and say who is where: Das Kind ist im Schlafzimmer.
grammar_function: Das ist die Küche. Subject + ist/sind + im/in der + room.
speaking_outcome: Name the rooms and say who is in them.
